clips.title: The story
paras: This critical stage of Raene Wolfrunner's mission requires the use of Dartol's newly restored rod to disguise an outsider and initiate contact with an uncorrupted furbolg. Southeast of Mystral Lake, an outcast named Krolg offers a rare glimpse into the surviving furbolgs' deep resentment toward the night elves.

With Dartol's Rod of Transformation restored, Raene Wolfrunner suspects the late night elf intended to disguise himself in order to safely approach the furbolgs. The woods of Ashenvale have grown perilous, and the madness spreading through the tribes makes direct diplomacy impossible. By harnessing the arcane relic, an adventurer takes on the appearance of a furbolg, hoping to slip past instinctive territorial rage and find someone willing to speak.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Alas, I'm not completely certain what he had in mind next.
If what he said was true about the rod's power, then it will allow you to take on another form altogether. Which form, I do not know.

Perhaps he meant to use its powers to get closer to the tainted furbolgs, but even the uncorrupted creatures would slaughter him were he not careful. Transformed by the rod, Dartol would have to speak to a furbolg who was safe from the effects of :Fel Moss.
I would start your search southeast of Mystral Lake.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, yes... You are one of my kind, but still whole. Still clean.
I am unsure how you have escaped the atrocities the night elves have visited upon our people, but I am glad to know that I am no longer alone.

Corruption now runs through the veins of our kin, young one, corruption brought down upon us by the prideful night elves. They are the ones who did this to our people... They are the ones I blame for being cast out of my tribe.
At night I can still see the campfires burning in the darkness.
